{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check: how many rows have revenue_float == 999999.99?
internal_test_rows = df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_test_rows)}")

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")

# Among completed, how many are internal test orders?
internal_test_in_completed = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders among completed: {len(internal_test_in_completed)}")

# Exclude internal test orders from completed
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]
print(f"Number of cleaned completed orders (excl. internal test): {len(df_clean)}")

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue_cleaned = df_clean['revenue_float'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue_cleaned}")"}
